title: Built-in success instinct metaphor
content: The chapter presents purposeful human problem-solving as analogous to an organism pursuing survival and meaningful goals. Animals’ navigational and survival instincts are used as a bridge to a wider human goal-seeking system that includes creativity and fulfillment.
